title: A Morning Walk by the River
paragraphs: Every morning before work, Rania walks by a small river near her home. She began this habit after a doctor told her to move more because her back often hurt.
At first, the walk feels like another task. Rania wants to finish it quickly and get ready for work.
After a few weeks, she starts to enjoy the walk. She sees herons in the shallow water and watches the sky change color.
Months later, the walk is not only exercise for Rania. It is also a quiet time before her day starts. She now looks forward to it every morning.
